title: CompareDR: Benchmarking Deep Research Reports from Individual Quality to Comparative Merit
abstract: arXiv:2611.29549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep research systems can produce reports with different evidence, analyses, and conclusions for the same query. A reader deciding which findings to rely on needs to know how well each report meets the task requirements and which differences matter to the answer. A score for a single report can summarize its quality, but it does not identify which contributions make one report more useful than another. We introduce CompareDR, a benchmark that combines task-specific pointwise audits with guideline-based pairwise comparisons. We use passage-linked report representations to locate relevant differences and selective evidence verification to check claims that could affect the judgment. The benchmark comprises 40 Chinese and English tasks from three existing benchmarks, 360 reports from nine systems, 1,099 human-reviewed evaluation criteria, and human preferences elicited through blinded comparisons of 80 report pairs. translated_title: CompareDR：从个体质量到比较优势的深度研究报告评测基准
translated_abstract: 深度研究系统针对同一查询可能产出包含不同证据、分析和结论的报告。读者在决定该依赖哪些研究发现时，需要了解每份报告满足任务要求的程度，以及哪些差异对答案至关重要。对单一报告进行评分可以概括其质量，但无法识别究竟是哪些因素使一份报告比另一份更有用。我们提出了CompareDR，这是一个结合任务特定逐点审查与基于准则的两两比较的评测基准。我们使用段落关联的报告表示来定位相关差异，并采用选择性证据验证来核查可能影响判断的论断。该基准包含来自三个现有基准的40个中英文任务、来自九个系统的360份报告、1,099条经人工审核的评估标准，以及通过对80对报告进行盲测比较所获得的人类偏好数据。
tldr: 提出了CompareDR基准，通过结合任务特定的逐点质量审查、基于准则的两两比较和选择性证据验证，实现对深度研究报告从个体质量到相对优势的全面评测。
en_tdlr: CompareDR, a benchmark that combines task-specific pointwise audits with guideline-based pairwise comparisons and selective evidence verification, evaluates deep research reports from individual quality to comparative merit.
